name: ENCODE HCT116 RAD21-degron in situ Hi-C (Aiden lab; Rao et al. 2017 Cell 171:305, 'Cohesin loss eliminates all loop domains')
what: HCT116 cells with an auxin-inducible degron on the cohesin subunit RAD21: untreated, 6 h auxin (cohesin destroyed), and 20 / 40 / 60 / 180 min after wash-out
also_there: intact Hi-C auxin time course at 10-180 min and 24 h (ENCSR357QXT ... ENCSR168NHR): how fast loops fade as cohesin is destroyed -- not used yet
use_for_cellbrain: G19-K1/K2/K3 (2026-11-28): cohesin loss removes 89% of loop signal; loops return within an hour of wash-out; compartments unchanged (r 0.98). Other inputs of G19/G20: JASPAR MA0139.1 (CC BY 4.0), UCSC hg38.2bit, ENCODE K562 histone peaks (Bernstein lab), Bond 2023 per-site tables (GSE213908 / GSE213295).
